rules.statement: Section 6 of Ordinance No. 12 of 1840 still has the force of law for all purposes in proceedings under the Waste Lands Ordinance, and cannot be rebutted by any means other than those provided in section 6.
rules.supporting_quote: "It does not seem necessary to say more than this. There is how-DALTON J ever one point I would wish to refer to in respect of the argument- put before us. It is admitted that section 6 either confers upon Special the Crown or declaratory of a very valuable right. I do not Officer think sufficient importance has been laid upon the word 'deem' in that section. Whether it be the creation of a new right or the statutory declaration of an existing right as would seem to be the case, that right cannot be taken away by inference in a later statute, unless the terms used make the inference irresistible."
